turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy from Lucknow?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Reddy. Who is this calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Sameer from Global Task Solutions, calling about your registration for the part-time data optimization project.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Registration? I do not remember signing up for any such thing, beta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It might have been through a social media ad, sir, but you were shortlisted for easy daily earnings just by clicking a few links.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am retired, I do not know much about these links. How much money are you talking about?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can earn thousands daily, and since you completed the trial, your wallet currently shows a profit of fifty thousand rupees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Fifty thousand! Truly? How do I get this money in my bank account?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To activate the withdrawal, the system requires a one-time security verification deposit of five thousand rupees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Why should I pay money to get my own profit? This sounds very strange.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is just a refundable tax fee, Mr. Reddy, and once you pay, the full fifty thousand will be credited instantly.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I have to ask my son first, I am not comfortable with this.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The offer expires in one hour, sir, so please just send the amount via UPI now to avoid losing your profit.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, please, let me check with my family first.
